full_map_attempt.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Asset type: high-resolution top-down 2D game terrain background, one single seamless-looking whole-map image. The attached image is the EDIT TARGET, not merely mood inspiration.
Primary request: faithfully repaint this exact terrain at a substantially HIGHER NATIVE RASTER RESOLUTION. Output a landscape image at 3072x2048 pixels or higher if supported, maximum available native resolution. Retain all the reference's entire map composition, road widths, road paths, joins and boundaries. Improve actual painted edge fidelity rather than blurring, smoothing or merely enlarging the old raster.
The world maps to 2200x1500 units. A broad horizontal ochre dirt trail crosses at approximately 50% image height. Its main vertical trail joins near 76% image width, coming from bottom, bends slightly then turns to the right at the upper right. The short spur near x18% rises from the horizontal trail. These exact connected path silhouettes and their locations must stay as in the reference; do not redesign the map.
Style: flat 2D relaxed hand-painted oil/gouache cartoon, matching the existing image. Broad irregular dabs of sage/moss/teal grass and warm pale ochre road, human-looking broken brush edges and variable overlapping short strokes. Large calm color masses, simple readable flat terrain, richer crisp painted boundaries and finer resolved strokes within the same broad style. Maintain exactly the same palette and soft overcast lighting. Not realism, not pixel art, not 3D, not vector shapes, no shiny polish, no photographic grass blades, no excessive sharp grain, no repeated stamped texture.
View must remain straight top-down, ground only. Do not add trees, houses, rocks, tall grasses, ponds, shadows, icons, characters, UI, frames, borders, writing or labels. No perspective, no horizon, no changed path layout, no new objects. Full bleed ground fills every pixel.
